meta.title: deskMonk — Smart solutions for a calm desk
meta.desc: deskMonk frees disk space, locks private files in an encrypted Vault, keeps you focused with Monk mode, maps your disk and shows your hardware. Free for macOS, Windows and Linux.
hero.title: Smart solutions for a calm desk.
hero.lead: deskMonk finds the gigabytes you no longer need, locks your private files in an encrypted Vault and keeps you focused while you work. Six tools, one quiet app, and your files never leave your computer.
hero.daypassSub: App Lock and Vault unlimited · via pelamx.com
gain.1: Duplicates, junk, old downloads and huge files, found in one scan.
gain.2: Strong encryption for the files only you should open.
gain.3: A 25-minute focus timer with a monk who keeps you company.
gain.4: Every part by brand and model, battery health and disk speed.
feat.title: Everything your computer needs, in one calm place
feat.lead: Instead of a cleaner, an encryption tool, a focus timer and a system profiler, you get one app that does all four, and does them without fuss.
clean.title: Free up space without the fear of deleting the wrong file
clean.p: Pick a folder or your whole home and press Scan. deskMonk sorts what it finds into four clear groups and shows how much space each one gives back, before anything is touched.
clean.l1: Duplicates: true copies only, matched byte for byte, so a file that merely has the same name is never flagged.
clean.l2: Junk files: app caches, the trash, temporary files, logs and old backups. Caches rebuild themselves when needed.
clean.l3: Old downloads: installers and files in Downloads you haven't touched for 90 days.
clean.l4: Large files: anything over 500 MB, the usual reason a disk is suddenly full.
clean.l5: You choose what goes. Everything except junk is moved to the Trash, so you can still change your mind.
clean.free: Free: clean up to 2 GB a day. Pro: unlimited.
vault.title: Lock away your private files with one password
vault.p: Drop a file or a whole folder, choose a password, done. Your tax returns, passport scans and contracts become a single encrypted .dmvault file that nobody can open without the password.
vault.l1: Strong, modern encryption (ChaCha20-Poly1305 with an Argon2id password key), the kind password managers use.
vault.l2: All your vaults are listed in one place. Click Open, type the password, and your files are back.
vault.l3: Safe to keep in Dropbox, iCloud, Google Drive or on a USB stick: the cloud only ever sees scrambled data.
vault.l4: Opening your vaults is always free, on any plan, forever.
vault.free: Free: 3 encryptions a day, up to 200 MB each. Pro: unlimited, any size.
monk.title: Focus like a monk, rest like one too
monk.p: A pomodoro timer with a friend. Press Start and the monk sits down to meditate while you work for 25 minutes; when it's time for a break, he stands up and stretches, and so should you.
monk.l1: Focus and break lengths you can set to fit how you work.
monk.l2: A gentle notification when a session ends, so you can stop watching the clock.
monk.l3: Counts your sessions, so you can see how much deep work you did today.
map.title: See where your disk space went, at a glance
map.p: Every folder is drawn as a box sized by how much it holds. The biggest boxes are where your space went; click one to step inside, or open it in Finder or Explorer.
map.l1: How full your disk is: used, total and free.
map.l2: Finds the forgotten video project or the 40 GB of old phone backups in seconds.
hw.title: Know exactly what is inside your computer
hw.p: Processor, memory, graphics, display, storage and battery, each with its brand and model, on one screen. Handy when you sell a laptop, buy a used one, or a support desk asks what you have.
hw.l1: Battery health and charge cycles: know when a battery is wearing out.
hw.l2: Disk speed test: real read and write speed of your drive in MB/s.
hw.l3: Memory maker, core counts, screen resolution and refresh rate, uptime.
lock.title: Keep curious eyes out of your apps
lock.p: Choose apps like Messages, Photos or WhatsApp. When someone opens one, deskMonk stops it and asks for your password; with the right password the app opens, and it locks again when it quits.
lock.l1: Ideal for a shared family Mac or a laptop you hand to someone for a minute.
lock.l2: One password for all locked apps.
lock.free: Free: lock 1 app. Pro: lock as many as you like.
priv.title: Your files are none of our business
priv.1: Scanning, cleaning and encryption run locally. No file, file name or password is ever sent anywhere.
priv.2: Download and use it. Pro is a license key, not an account.
priv.3t: Statistics only if you say yes
priv.3: Anonymous counts (how much was found, which features are used), never contents. Off unless you allow it.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Nothing is deleted until you press Clean, and you see every file first. Everything except junk goes to the Trash, so you can put it back. Junk means caches, temporary files and logs that apps recreate on their own.
faq.q2: What if I forget a Vault password?
faq.a2: Then the vault can't be opened, not by you and not by us. That is what makes it safe. Write the password down somewhere safe.
faq.q3: Is the free plan really free?
faq.a3: Yes. No trial period, no card, no account. The free plan has every feature with small daily limits; most people never need more.
faq.q4: How does Pro work on several computers?
faq.a4: After buying you get a license key. Enter it in deskMonk under "Have a license key?" on up to 3 computers. Bought from inside the app, that computer turns Pro by itself.
faq.q5: How do I cancel, or get a refund?
faq.a5: Cancel anytime from deskMonk (⭐ Pro → Manage subscription) or on your account page; you keep Pro until the end of the paid period. Within 14 days of paying you get a full refund, no questions asked.
faq.a6: Paddle, our merchant of record. It processes the card, handles tax for your country and sends your receipt. We never see your card details.

how.title: How buying works
how.1: The easiest way: in deskMonk, press ⭐ Get Pro. That computer turns Pro by itself after you pay.
how.2: Buying on this site gives you a license key right after payment. Enter it in deskMonk under "Have a license key?" on up to 3 computers.
how.3: Payments are handled by Paddle, our reseller and merchant of record. Paddle shows any sales tax for your country before you pay and emails your receipt.
how.4: The subscription renews automatically until you cancel. Cancel in the app (⭐ Pro → Manage subscription), on your license page, or by writing to support@deskmonk.app; you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for.
how.5: Not happy? Ask within 14 days for a full refund. See the refund policy.
how.6: In the Mac App Store version, Pro is an Apple subscription that Apple bills and you manage in your Apple account. App lock is not part of the App Store version.
